# gitlab — 2024 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 186 gitlab CVEs of 2024 are in `data/cve/vendors/gitlab/2024.jsonl`.

### CVE-2024-0199 — Incorrect Authorization in GitLab
- Assigner: GitLab | Published: 2024-03-07 | Updated: 2025-04-16 | Max CVSS: 7.7
- CWE: CWE-863 CWE-863: Incorrect Authorization
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.7 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

An authorization bypass vulnerability was discovered in GitLab affecting versions 11.3 prior to 16.7.7, 16.7.6 prior to 16.8.4, and 16.8.3 prior to 16.9.2. An attacker could bypass CODEOWNERS by utilizing a crafted payload in an old feature branch to perform malicious actions.

**solutions:** Upgrade to versions 16.7.7, 16.8.4, 16.9.2 or above.

Affected:
- GitLab / GitLab: affected 11.3 <16.7.7 (semver); affected 16.8 <16.8.4 (semver); affected 16.9 <16.9.2 (semver)

Credits: Thanks [ali_shehab](https://hackerone.com/ali_shehab) for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program

References:
- https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/436977 [issue-tracking,permissions-required]
- https://hackerone.com/reports/2295423 [technical-description,exploit,permissions-required]
- https://about.gitlab.com/releases/2024/03/06/security-release-gitlab-16-9-2-released/

Missing authorization in Client-Server API in Conduit <=0.7.0, allowing for any alias to be removed and added to another room, which can be used for privilege escalation by moving the #admins alias to a room which they control, allowing them to run commands resetting passwords, siging json with the server's key, deactivating users, and more

- The Conduit Contributors / Conduit: affected 0 <0.8.0 (semver)
